mapMainService(s) = if (s is String) { name: s, productType: null, products: [] } else if (s is Object) { name: s.nombre default s.name, productType: s.tipoProducto default s.productType, products: (s.productos default s.products default []) map ((p) -> mapMainService(p)) } else s fun mapOffer(o) = { id: mapId(o."_id"), groupingNumber: o.numAgrupacion, configurationCode: o.codConfiguracion, name: o.nombre, commercialName: o.nombreComercial, bundleType: o.tipoBundle, productType: o.tipoProducto, serviceType: o.tipoServicio, serviceSubtype: o.subtipoServicio, planDescription: o.descripcionPlan, mainServices: (o.serviciosPrincipales default []) map ((s) -> mapMainService(s)), price: { priceWithoutTax: (o.precio default {}).precioSinIva, priceWithTax: (o.precio default {}).precioConIva, tax: (o.precio default {}).iva, salesChannel: (o.precio default {}).canalVenta }, channels: o.canales default [], businessUnit: o.uen default [], catalogBusinessUnit: o.uenCatalogo default [], profile: o.perfil default [], scoring: o.scoring default [], strata: o.estratos default [], procedures: o.tramites default [], technologies: o.tecnologias default [], billing: o.facturacion default [], capabilities: { appointment: (o.capacidades default {}).agendamiento, availability: (o.capacidades default {}).disponibilidad, provisioning: (o.capacidades default {}).aprovisionamiento, billing: (o.capacidades default {}).facturacion }, characteristics: o.caracteristicas default [], technicalSpecifications: o.especificacionesTecnicas default [], promotions: o.promociones default [], image: { url: (o.imagen default {}).url, blobName: (o.imagen default {}).blobName, templateVersion: (o.imagen default {}).versionPlantilla, generationDate: (o.imagen default
